subject.title: feat(ledger): add immutable action history core

question: Should ClawSweeper stabilize this broad schema-v1 ledger contract before any production workflow lane consumes it?
rationale: The schema, producer identities, privacy vocabulary, shard layout, and exported helpers become long-lived compatibility boundaries, so tests alone cannot determine when the architecture should freeze.

options.title: Stabilize after integrated proof
options.body: Keep the draft open until https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/512 demonstrates the complete lifecycle through a representative workflow.

options.title: Merge the isolated core
options.body: Accept the current contract now while explicitly owning possible schema or storage migrations during later instrumentation.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Reduce schema v1 and the exported helper surface to the minimum demonstrated by the first production consumer.

recommendation.title: Stabilize after integrated proof
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open until https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/512 demonstrates the complete lifecycle through a representative workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The broadest historical ownership signal across the sweep workflow and durable automation architecture makes this the best available final decision owner.
